title: This Moth Jams a Bat's Sonar With Its Own Clicks

scenes.text: A moth fights bats by jamming their sonar.
Bats hunt in the dark by shouting and listening for the echo.
But the tiger moth shouts back, with thousands of ultrasonic clicks every second.
The clicks blur the echo, so the bat knows a moth is near but not where.
In experiments, big brown bats kept attacking and struggled to catch them.
The moth shouts. The bat misses.

description:
A moth fights bats by jamming their sonar.
The tiger moth Bertholdia trigona answers an attacking bat with ultrasonic clicks that blur the echo the bat is trying to read.
Which would you rather be, the moth or the bat?
first_comment: A moth that fights back with sound. Which animal's defense is your favorite?
